shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && find .agents -type f && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && git show --stat HEAD | head -50
cat package.json src/*.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; ls __agent_eval__; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md

grep -n -A 25 "@gravity-ui/navigation\`" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; grep -n -A 20 "@gravity-ui/icons\`" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 @gravity-ui/icons@^2.23.1 @bem-react/classname@^1.6.0 2>&1 | tail -5 && cat package.json | sed -n 9,16p && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build 2>/dev/null; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader PageLayout FooterItem 2>&1 | head -40
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader FooterItem 2>&1 | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -60
sed -n 60,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md; ls -R node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs | head -40

wc -l node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; grep -n -E "^#|renderFooter|FooterItem|onItemClick|current|MenuItem|headerDecoration|hideCollapseButton|onClosePanel|subheaderItems|logo" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -80
D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; sed -n 80,117p $D; sed -n 253,258p $D; sed -n 309,316p $D; sed -n 354,405p $D; sed -n 470,512p $D

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; sed -n 354,405p $D | cut -c1-260 | grep -E "compact|renderContent|renderFooter|menuItems|logo|onChangeCompact"; sed -n 470,512p $D | cut -c1-220 | grep -E "^\| (id|title|icon|current|onItemClick|href|tooltipText) "; grep -rn "FooterItem" node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm -name "FooterItem*.d.ts" | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm -path "*Logo*" -name "*.d.ts" | head

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; cat $N/index.d.ts | head -40; cat $N/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts; cat $N/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts; grep -n "renderFooter\|renderContent" -A3 $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -30

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; cat $N/components/index.d.ts | grep -n "FooterItem\|AsideHeader\|Logo"; grep -n "RenderContentType" -A3 $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head; grep -n "interface LogoProps" -A20 $N/components/types.d.ts; grep -n "export interface AsideHeaderItem\|export type AsideHeaderItem" -A30 $N/components/types.d.ts | head -50

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; grep -n "FooterItem\|export" $N/components/AsideHeader/index.d.ts; grep -n "RenderContentType" -A4 $N/components/Content/*.d.ts | head; grep -n "MenuItem\b\|interface MenuItem\|type MenuItem" $N/components/types.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "AsideHeaderItem" $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -3

wc -l .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && grep -n "^#" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head

sed -n 15,181p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; sed -n 224,252p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; sed -n 306,373p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md | head -40; I=node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons; ls $I; for n in House ListCheck Gear Sun Moon CircleCheck Clock LayoutCellsLarge ChartColumn Planet; do ls $I/$n.d.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "MISSING $n"; done

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; for c in SegmentedRadioGroup Card Label Checkbox Switch TextInput; do echo "== $c"; ls $U/$c/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; done; grep -n "view\|theme\|type\b\|size" $U/Card/Card.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "export interface SegmentedRadioGroupProps" -A12 $U/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; grep -n "theme\b\|LabelProps\b" $U/Label/Label.d.ts | head; grep -n "ThemeProvider\|useTheme\|ThemeType\|Theme\b" $U/theme/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls $U/theme 2>/dev/null | head -20

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $U/theme/types.d.ts | head -20; cat $U/theme/useThemeType.d.ts; grep -n "ControlGroupProps\b" -A15 $U/types.d.ts | head -25; cat $U/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts | head -20; sed -n 4,40p $U/Label/Label.d.ts; grep -n "interface\|onUpdate\|checked\|content\|size" $U/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head; ls $U/layout; grep -n "spacing\|gap\|direction\|wrap" $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n "export interface ControlProps" -A14 $U/types.d.ts; grep -n "onUpdate\|onKeyDown\|placeholder\|hasClear\|value?" $U/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts $U/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "alignItems\|justifyContent\|grow\|shrink" $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; grep -n "spacing" $U/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -3; sed -n 1,40p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | grep -n "Container\|maxWidth\|spacing" | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; sed -n 1,80p $U/Button/Button.d.ts | grep -n "aria\|extends\|view\|size\|width\|onClick\|selected" | head -20; grep -n "Icon\b" $U/Button/Button.d.ts | head -5

for t in color-base-info-light color-text-info color-line-generic border-radius-l spacing-8 spacing-6 spacing-5 spacing-4 spacing-3 spacing-2; do printf "%s: " $t; grep -o -- "--g-$t:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -1 | wc -l; done; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
cat .gitignore; sed -i 's/<html lang="en">/<html lang="ru">/; s#<title>Gravity UI eval</title>#<title>Мини-приложение</title>#' index.html; git status --short
rm -rf dist
